notes.title: Bartlow's Dread Machine Winter 2020 Update-aganza
notes.content:
- The Agent character can now be changed between levels instead of requiring a separate play-through. Once you unlock a new hero you can play them the very next level.

- The game’s difficulty setting can be changed at any time – between or during levels.

- Finishing the game formerly scrubbed the current saved game after the final boss was defeated. Saves now persist so you can go back for unlockable characters you may have missed. 

- Added an option to start a new saved game with gear and money zeroed out. These will still exist in previously saved games.

- Several difficulty spikes have been smoothed out, notably the jungle and temple levels in the fifth world.

- Cash accrues more quickly in the game’s later levels, making it possible to buy more of the advanced weapons for those final big battles.

- Fixed a bug where defeating a boss didn’t give players cash.

- Sundry bug fixes and AI tweaks.

To celebrate, we’re putting the game on sale for two weeks starting December 24th. We hope everyone enjoys the update!

notes.content:

notes.title: The Canal Zone
notes.content:
-World 5 "The Canal Zone" with 4 new levels.
-Two new Unlockable characters!
-New Enemies

New Features:
-Corner Sensitivity, you can now change the corner sensitivity for a different feel.  Great for players who have trouble getting around corners.
-Left trigger deflect, you can now use left trigger to deflect as well as A.

Bug fixes.
-fixes issue where player could walk off screen in some unintended situations.
-fixed performance issue that could crop up if game was left idle during dialogue in some boss fights.
-improved debris bounce sound.
-FPS cannon sound has more kaboom for your ka-buck.
-Fixed softlock that could be caused if you were killed at the same time you killed the sniper in world 2_2

Checkout the trailer! [url=https://youtu.be/pf7v_LFiiU0]HERE![/url]

notes.title: Open Beta!
notes.content:
Our process with new changes going forward:
1) we make the changes
2) we do internal testing
3) we push changes to open_beta 
4) Once the community ok's the update we will make the changes available to everyone in Early Access 

So if you'd like to see the newest stuff before anyone else and don't mind a few extra bugs.  Check out the open beta!   Instructions below.


General Directions:
1) right click "Bartlow's Dread Machine"
2) select properies
3) select the beta tab
4) type in access code: iWillFindBugs
5) click "Check Code"
6) change the build to opt into: open_beta

Detailed directions on how to access the open beta here:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DZo1chHlWqoH3MI_LXx6rgrpHpAysSZZNHW2I2GLSCQ/edit?usp=sharing


Open Beta has the following new content:
-World 5 "Panama!" with 4 new levels.
-New Unlockable character.
-New Equipment
-New Enemies
-New Options based on community feedback.

New Features:
-Corner Sensitivity, you can now change the corner sensitivity for a different feel.  Great for players who have trouble getting around corners.
-Left trigger deflect, you can now use left trigger to deflect as well as A.

Open Beta has the following bug fixes.
-fixes issue where player could walk off screen in some unintended situations.
-fixed performance issue that could crop up if game was left idle during dialogue in some boss fights.
-improved debris bounce sound.
-FPS cannon sound has more kaboom for your ka-buck.
-Fixed softlock that could be caused if you were killed at the same time you killed the sniper in world 2_2

notes.title: To Sea!
notes.content:
-World 4 "To Sea!" with 4 new levels.
-New Unlockable character.
-New Equipment
-New Enemies
-fixes rare issue where player cannot teleport back on screen in coop.
-game will no longer degrade in performance when left idle in some situations.
-Station master boss fight tentacles  will no longer block projectiles during their death animation.
-2nd player can no longer get stuck outside the room with the first Slugger fight in Level 1-3.
-Stacking melee resist will no longer heal you in some rare instances.
